prompts.title: Aesthetic Woman with Floral Basket & Vintage Bike
prompts.prompt:
Create a ultra-realistic cinematic editorial photography with a soft, poetic Pinterest aesthetic. Natural storytelling, authentic textures, subtle analog film grain, soft color grading, shallow depth of field, elegant composition, timeless atmosphere.
A young woman sits gracefully on a vintage pastel-blue Dutch bicycle in front of a large weathered blue wooden door made of vertical panels. The paint is gently faded, revealing aged wood beneath. The door features large antique brass handles with a soft green patina. Beside it stands a tall arched glass window with matching blue wooden frames and vertical panels. Both the door and window are closed. The surrounding wall is aged white plaster with delicate cracks and climbing ivy vines growing naturally around the arch.
The woman wears a light blue cotton button-up shirt with sleeves casually rolled up and high-waisted blue flared jeans. She rests one foot on the cobblestone ground and the other lightly on the pedal. Her body faces slightly toward the camera while her gaze looks gently downward to the left, creating a quiet, contemplative mood. Her hair moves softly in a gentle breeze.
The bicycle features cream-colored tires and a white wicker basket overflowing with fresh flowers in shades of blue, white, green, and a few deep burgundy-red accents, including blue hydrangeas, delphiniums, baby's breath, eucalyptus, and dark red roses. A small cream-colored handwritten letter peeks naturally from among the flowers.
A white cat sleeps peacefully on the stone step beside the blue door, adding warmth and a sense of everyday life to the scene.
Blue flower petals are scattered naturally across the cobblestone pavement. Soft blurred blue flowers frame the foreground, creating dreamy foreground bokeh and cinematic depth. The upper portion of the composition contains generous negative space, allowing the magnificent blue door to dominate the frame.
Soft overcast afternoon light illuminates the scene evenly, producing gentle shadows and smooth skin tones. The color palette is dominated by dusty blue, ivory white, sage green, warm brass, soft cream, muted stone gray, and subtle burgundy accents. The overall feeling is quiet, nostalgic, romantic, elegant, and timeless.
Captured with a full-frame mirrorless camera, 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, ultra-photorealistic, highly detailed skin texture, realistic fabric folds, natural colors, cinematic composition, 8k UHD, editorial magazine quality, no yellow color cast.
